disposition: ABANDON THE ITEM AND LEAVE THE HOLE FOR A FRESH SPEC. That is the reviewer's own recommendation, recorded in the journal. NOT because the work is bad - the derivation half is genuinely good - but because the item has now spent NINE rounds and the SAME defect class keeps reappearing in a new spelling: round 5 guarded the constructor, 6 the argument, 7 the origin by work tree, 9 the write-surface discovery, and the door is still open one directory down. THE REASON IS ARCHITECTURAL, NOT A MISSING CASE: the projection has no notion of ITS OWN DOMAIN as the authority. log_entitlement asks 'do these two paths share a work tree', when the only defensible question is 'is this key one derived from the enumeration rooted at the repository THE LOG SITS IN'. The reviewer's proposed fresh spec has ONE acceptance criterion: the reconciler's landed lines are read back, and every verdict_path on a verdict.recorded line this pass appended must be a member of `git ls-files 'proof/*/verdict*.json'` run at the LOG'S OWN root, with the negative control being a committed verdict-shaped file in a sibling directory of the same work tree. It also recommends considering DELETING --repo-root and --log from the shipped CLI and giving the selftest an internal entry point instead, since 'test-only flags' are what both the round-7 hole and this one were built out of. IF THE OWNER PREFERS ONE MORE SCOPED ROUND instead of a re-spec, the minimum bar is: the invariant restated as the DOMAIN and not the work tree, the readback extended from the hand-emission door to the reconciler's own landed bytes, and the false sentences DELETED rather than narrowed - three of which this state wrote, in sixteen engine copies, in the paragraph that deletes the previous one.
